chunks: This, Our record, will speak about you truthfully. We had everything you did recorded in it.

key_terms.کِتَابُنَا: Our Book (referring to the Book of Deeds)

ai.seo_question: What is the Book of Deeds and how does it testify against people on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Kitab al-A'mal' (Book of Deeds) as a living witness that speaks with divine truth, underscoring Allah's precise preservation of every human action. It serves as a powerful reminder of individual accountability, where the record itself testifies against or for the soul, reflecting the meticulous nature of divine knowledge.
